summary: The candidate 'LLM Event Tracking and Logging' describes the logical outcome of event capture, but the peer candidates reveal the actual implementation pattern: Provider Method Override (c4c70be4) handles transparent interception of LLM calls via method patching, and Span Management (cf066521) handles structured recording of those events with attributes. The candidate should merge into these two complementary skills rather than exist as a separate capability, as it represents the combined execution of their workflows. The existing skills in the registry (web fonts, Spring Boot conventions) are unrelated and should not be modified.
